title: Rainbow Blast
text: “Umm… hmm…”
“Na-Naofumi-sama, could that person possibly be…”
“Hey, hey, Master, could that person possibly be—”
“—You must not reveal a hero’s true identity!”
At that moment, Fleon-chan interrupted Big Sister and Filo-tan’s conversation by shouting a warning. Well, he’s clearly an Itsuki, no matter how you look at it.
“Is that okay?”
“Y-yes…”
“Huh?”
Filo-tan is tilting her little head in confusion.
“Filo, just go along with it—it’s a hassle. Don’t worry about who they really are.”
“Got it—”
Just as she said that, a loud, cackling laugh rang out.
“Hmm?”
Filo-tan is pricking up her ears. What a cute pose.
“Ha ha ha ha! It seems a fierce battle is about to break out! Is this the decisive battlefield, ≪Catastrophe≫?”
A black silhouette emerged from a cloud of dust. With a loud whoosh, it leaped high into the air and struck a pose.
“You can’t just forget about us…”
As if in sync with Black Thunder, Ren—wearing a black mask and having emerged from stealth—appeared, his cloak fluttering in the wind.
“The Dark Swordsman <SHADOW S'yne>… here I am.”
“Huh… A new page in the *Chronicle* of the Dark Brave’s adventures is about to be written here. Shadow S'yne, don’t fall behind this jet-black lightning bolt.”
“Hmph… I know. You, on the other hand, better not fall behind my dark power.”
“Ha ha ha! Then let’s get this show on the road! You, the <Evil Bishop> of an evil religion that preaches holiness! Be carved away and vanish in the whirlwind of darkness!”

With that, Ren and Black Thunder struck their poses once more. It’s a pose with a different vibe than the one Fleon and the others do. Their fingers are bent at such an extreme angle—it’s kind of unsettling. I wonder how they manage to do that finger pose?
“Um… That’s a Filolial too, right? A black Filolial.”
“It’s like a Philo clearance sale.”
“Eh…”
My fiancée and my father are talking while looking at Black Thunder.
“Um… Naofumi-sama, what should I do?”
“I don’t know…”

For some reason, my father is glaring at me. It seems both Itsuki and Ren have met Fleon-chan and Black Thunder, respectively. Both of them look like they’re having a great time playing with Ren and Itsuki. Ren and Itsuki seem to be playing along with them, too. They look kind of happy, if I’m not mistaken. I guess meeting Filolial-sama really does change people.
“Boo-boo! Boo-boo-hee! Boo-hee! Oink-oink!”
The Crimson Swine is squealing even louder, but I can’t make head or tail of it.
“It’s fine to play dumb, but isn’t there an evil you need to fight right there?”
Fleon-chan is pointing at the Crimson Swine and scolding it.
“Bubibuhi! Bubu!”
The Crimson Swine is taking this opportunity to wrap itself around my arm. Ugh! Let go!

“Well now… I don’t know who you are or where you’re from, but to call us—who have offered prayers to save the world and set out to defeat the Shield Demon—‘evil’… you’re quite the hypocrites, aren’t you? Everyone, do not be misled. The evil truth is always tied to the Shield Demon.”
“So whenever something bad happens, it’s all my fault… You’ve got to be kidding me.”
Father retorts to the Pope in an irritated tone.
“That attack just now cannot be overlooked. Besides… I see right through your schemes. I’ve figured out what the truth really is!”
“Even if the Holy Bird’s Saints and their party did something that worked against you, it’s also a fact that their actions saved people!”
“We could have joined hands. Yet, since you refused to extend a helping hand, you have no right to punish anyone!”
In response to Fleon-chan’s words, Itsuki declares:
“That’s right! We’ll make you, the wicked Church, learn firsthand what true darkness is.”
“Hah… Compared to the Abyss, you lot are nothing but a joke.”
I don’t really understand what Black Thunder and Ren are saying. Just then, as we delivered our parting words to the Pope, he—still smiling—pulled out that same old weapon he always uses.

“How unfortunate. Well then… this is a holy war for the sake of this country—and ultimately, the entire world. It is a battle for our church to exterminate the Shield Demon, who tempts and leads the people astray, and the three false heroes who shake the people’s faith, thereby solidifying our authority and prestige. It’s a sad state of affairs, but let us condemn you as allies of the Demon of the Shield… It seems that all of those who posed as heroes this time were, without exception, servants of the Demon of the Shield.”
The Pope says this as if he’s complaining.
“As a small gesture of mercy, I shall reveal your misdeeds here.”
It seems he’s determined to say this, no matter what. Fleon and the others still seem eager to continue their conversation; they show no signs of attacking the Pope.

“Yes… the faith of this nation is being shaken by these false heroes, each causing trouble in their respective regions. The False Sword Hero spreads plagues and disrupts the ecosystem; the False Spear Hero unleashes sealed monsters; and the False Bow Hero shows no authority and torments my followers. To top it all off… to anticipate our actions and resort to such bizarre behavior…”
“That’s right! You lot! I will never forgive you!”
Oh? For some reason, there’s a Smoked Meat figure behind the Pope.
“Who’s that over there! I suspected as much—it really is you! This Filolial Mask No. 2 will put an end to you!”
“Shut up! You so-called ‘Bow Hero’! You lot, who let yourselves be fooled by that bird-woman’s ramblings, aren’t heroes at all! Receive God’s Judgment and perish in the name of justice!”
Smoked Meat being on the Pope’s side—that’s a better turn of events than if he’d made a reckless move. Let’s just wipe them out while we’re on this roll.

“Oh dear… Even after being judged by us once, you still haven’t learned your lesson and have gone over to the enemy’s side… So, you really were just brandishing your selfish sense of justice to line your own pockets, weren’t you?”
It’s Itsuki—who should be completely ignoring his own faults—who replies to Smoked Meat, as if sighing.
“It seems Filolial Mask No. 2 has a keen eye. It appears… Rishia was the only one who truly possessed a sense of justice.”
“B-b-bleh…?”
Itsuki stares at the stalker pig, who’s either frozen in fear or twitching uncontrollably.
“Oink oink heh!”
The Crimson Swine is grunting triumphantly here, but I have absolutely no interest in what it’s saying. It’s bound to be something worthless anyway.
“Princess Malty. We’ve already prepared someone to succeed you as ruler. It’s all by the will of the gods. Let’s dispose of you along with that Spear imposter.”
“Oink-oink-oink!”

The Crimson Swine is acting all cocky for no reason as he brushes me off. He must think I’m going to fight in his place. “This is where you step in!” I have no idea how good it would feel to kick him right out of the way, but I’ll hold back.
“It seems we must purify the Demon of the Shield as well.”
The Pope channels his power into his weapon and raises it to strike.
“Naofumi! Be careful—that thing is—”
My Finacée gasps in shock at the sight of the Pope’s weapon.
“First, the Shield Demon. Receive God’s Judgment!”
As the Pope swings his weapon, I step even further in front of my future Father—who’s about to step forward—and swing my spear to deflect the shockwave.
“W-What!? Gwaaaaaaah…—”

Oh, it grazed the Smoked Meat and sent him flying. But he probably won’t die from something like that. Sure enough, even though he was knocked back, he staggered back to his feet. Tsk… I really wanted to finish him off while I had the chance.
“W-what? No, t-that can’t be possible.”

Oh? The Pope let out a cry of surprise, though he seems to be trying to stay calm. You lot aren’t even needed here. Either way, the queens will be rushing over here any second now. We might as well end this fight quickly.

“Everyone! Let’s join forces! Come on, stack our weapons for a finishing move! Naofumi-san, you’re first!　You’ll be the base—place your shield at the bottom, then Motoyasu-san’s spear, followed by No. 3… no, Perfect Justice-san’s bow, and finally the sword of the Dark Swordsman <SHADOW S'yne>. Then, I and Jet-Black Lightning will channel our power from the left and right, and—um… you!”
“Filo?”
Fleon-chan points at Filo-tan right here.
“That’s right. You’ll spread your wings behind Naofumi-san and concentrate your power. Then, the two princesses over there will weave their Magic.”
“Um, me and… that person over there are being ignored…”
“B-buh…?”
Big Sister and the stalker pig look a bit lonely. Their ears and tails are drooping straight down.
“Bub! Bubuhi-bububub! Buh-hee!”
The Crimson Swine is squealing in an unpleasant voice. You’d better shut up.
“Um… well…”
After glancing at the Crimson Swine, my Finacée turned her attention back to Fleon-chan and my future Fathers.
“You’re not really getting into the spirit of things. We should all be working together here. On the count of three! Then we fire! The battle cry is ‘Rainbow Blast!’ On the count of three—”
“Who’s going to do that?! That’s disgusting!”
My father shot down Fleon-chan’s suggestion right there. Hmm? I thought if we released the Brionac in sync with the launch, it would look pretty convincing.
“Who gave you that idea… or rather, is that even possible!?”
“I’ve never actually tried it.”
“It sounds like a good finishing move.”
“It’s not.”
“I’m not into hanging out in groups…”
“Then don’t come. Why did you even come here!?”
“I was guided by Fate ≪Sadame≫.”
My Father let out a sigh of exasperation directed at Ren.
“What happened to you guys in such a short time…? No, maybe brainwashing really does exist…”
“Naofumi-sama, pull yourself together!”
“Now! Everyone, begin the incantation of Judgment. All who side with the impostor are evil!”
Seizing this opening, the Pope gave his subordinates instructions to cast Ceremonial Magic.
“I won’t let you!”
“Justice!”
“Yes! Meteor Bow!”
At this moment, Itsuki draws her bow and unleashes her Skills.
“‘‘‘Gyaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!?’’’’”

Countless stars rained down from the arrow Ju fired, showering the followers of the Three Heroes Church. With a loud crash, the Magic barrier shattered like candy. In practically a single strike, the right flank of the group behind the Pope was rendered incapacitated.
“Hundred Swords!”
As Ren raised his sword and chanted the Skills, a rain of countless swords poured down on the left flank.
“““Wh—Waaaaaah!”””
And with that, the left flank was completely wiped out. This power… It seems Ren and Itsuki truly trusted the enhancements that Fleon-chan and Black Thunder taught them, respectively.
“No… this can’t be… the believers who prepared for the Holy War…”
With a stunned expression, the Pope glanced back over his shoulder.
“Well then… I guess it’s up to me to finish this off!”
I’ll put all my strength into this spear.
“Oink! Oink-heh-heh! Oink!”
“Big Sis…”
There are a whole bunch of guys lined up here who’d be a huge pain if they survived across countless worlds… so let’s take them all out in one go.
“Everyone! Here we go! Haaaaaaaah!”
“Oinkkkkk!”
I’m putting all my strength into the spear to unleash a Brionac! It’s a Rainbow Blast!
Ugh… the Crimson Swine is casting Magic. The Crimson Swine’s magic has combined with my spear, triggering a fusion skill!
“Flare Brionac X! Here we go—!”
With a whoosh, I’ll sweep a fire-attribute Brionac across the field to wipe out the Popes all at once.
“Wh—what, oh God—”
“Gya, gyaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!”
In an instant, I’ve wiped out the popes and the Three Heroes Church. Smoked Meat is still as loud as ever.

That’s what I thought, but the moment the Flare Brionac hit, the popes were blown to smithereens. Fleon-chan, Itsuki, Ren, and Black Thunder swayed slightly and turned their backs to strike a pose. So I followed suit, turning toward my Father and striking a victory pose. With a loud “boom,” Smoked Meat and his former comrades—including Itsuki—along with the Pope and the Three Heroes Church were wiped out right there on the spot.
“Victory!”
“This is how evil is vanquished.”
“B-b-bwaaah…”
That’s what Fleon-chan and Itsuki say. And the Stalker Pig is making some kind of incomprehensible sound.
“Another one has vanished into the darkness…”
“Darkness returns only to darkness… Hmph…”
Ren and Black Thunder are saying something. His fingers are bent at an incredible angle again. It might be his own unique way of expressing himself.
“Boo-hee-hee! Bub! Bub-bub!”

After the Crimson Swine let out some kind of cry here, he backed away from my Father and the others and started squealing. It seems he’s trying to start the second round, but it’s already over. Countless footsteps from afar… An army is approaching. And at the head of it is the Queen.
“Ah, Mother.”
The Finacée notices the Queen and calls out to her.
“Well… I heard reports that the Pope’s faction from the Three Heroes Church had appeared, so I rushed over here…”
The Queen looks around and seems to be explaining the situation.
“So you’re that Queen… You’re a step too late. The folks here just finished off some weird, high-and-mighty religious bigwigs like they were monsters about to explode.”
Sword… 50%
